summary: Diagnosed duplicate blocked notifications in Telegram goal handlers: `handleGoalApprove`/`handleGoalAnswer` could return `Run blocked: ...` after `onStatusChange` had already sent a `fully_blocked` DAG message. Added `trackBlockedStatusChange` to suppress the fallback text only when `fully_blocked` was already emitted, while preserving pre-execution blocked text when no status event was sent. Updated tests to cover both suppression and pre-execution fallback, and verified with `pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts` (72/72 passing). Also ran CLI self-verification commands via `node scripts/run-node.mjs goal --help`, `node scripts/run-node.mjs goal list`, and a blocked resume scenario under `MOLTBOT_STATE_DIR=/tmp/moltbot-goal-verify`.
